reviews.text: Paws solutions have been a god send for me and my etremely anxious Yorkshire terrier Wei has been amazing I have brought my dog to so many different groomers and I would be barly home when id get a phone call to come back as they couldn't do her she is still anxious going in but Wei is so good at what she does and hasn't given up on her ..thanks to all the team in paw solutions

Fantastic service and really looked after my dog. Got a quick appointment but advised them my dog had a cut on his ear before he was groomed. They were amazingly gentle with him and took really good care of him. Would highly recommend.

My poodle had her first poodle-style groom today, and I couldn’t be happier with the result! She looks absolutely beautiful. The groomer did an amazing job, and everyone was so kind and caring. Thank you for taking such great care of her. Highly recommend!

Totally recommend Paws solutions for anyone who wants to train in dog grooming or upskill. Wei & Andy helped me achieve my level 3 diploma and taught me many skills to improve my dog grooming and make my business a success. You have to be open to learning hands on and being open minded. There is a lot of information to take in but Wei guides you every step of the way. 💯
Very happy with my two dogs' wash and cut!

We have brought all of our family dogs here over the years and have always been happy with the service! Our cocker spaniel Reggie had his first ever groom here today and we’re so happy with the results, the girls did exactly what we asked and they were all really lovely and looked after him so well. Would highly recommend!!

Booked Golden Retriever, Archie  to be groomed with Paw Solutions, Maypark. We are so happy with the quality of his grooming and the attention to detail by the staff. He looks so well and we will most definitely book this service again. Highly recommend Paw Solutions, Maypark.

⚠️BE CAREFUL⚠️Got quoted €75, for small to medium dog, when I picked up the dog was told it was €90(Dog need "two extra showers"). Also when i explained this to the manager she never gave notice of extra cost and was very unhelpful. ⚠️AVOID⚠️ if possible. €90 for a full groom for a small to medium dog is excessive to say the least. Very disappointed😮‍💨😠 🐕

Lovely team and service! I called for a nails appointment, and I was friendly told to walk in. So I did, getting there I've felt that they love their job! Great place. Nails trimming for my dog (medium) 15 euros.

What can I say only thank you so much.I brought my terrified dog to have his nails cut,he is so nervous, we have attempted nail cuts before absolute disaster, this was my last hope, as the vet had previously tried to cut them gave my dog back 3 nails trimmed and told me  he would have to be sedated the next time I brought him. Well after 15 min all nails cut,what nice kind understanding groomers highly recommend 👌

I brought my labrador Willow here twice so far and will keep coming back. Willow is a nervous rescue who had never been to the groomers before and the staff were absolutely lovely and took great care of her both times. She came back smelling lovely and had everything trimmed and clipped perfectly.

Poppy had her grooming session here yesterday. She's a toy poodle with a mischievous  streak who gets into everything  she shouldn't!!! She's delighted  with  herself ,looks  great .They did a fantastic  job  although  it was expensive  at 80 euros.Shes a dote!!!
Always a great cut for our Cockapoo
